svg.title: Ask Artha read-only assistant architecture
svg.desc: Read-only assistant architecture in which FastAPI builds canonical facts, Gemini selects an intent and React renders only exact validated UI bundles.

g.text: Generative interaction, authoritative numbers and UI owned by the application
the model chooses from facts; it does not manufacture them
Database facts in. Safe repository UI out.
No chain-of-thought is exposed or required.
